headline: New law requires federal energy regulators to report to Congress each year on the status of hydropower dam license renewals.
what_it_does: The law directs the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) to send Congress a yearly report. The report must give the status of the renewal process for each application to renew a hydropower dam license.

who_it_affects.how: It must prepare and send Congress an annual report on every pending hydropower license renewal.

who_it_affects.group: Companies and utilities that operate hydropower dams
who_it_affects.how: The status of their license renewal applications will be tracked and reported to Congress each year.
They will receive yearly updates on where each hydropower relicensing case stands.
